component.name: RelayItem
component.script:
sub init() m.cardBg = m.top.findNode("cardBg") m.focusBorder = m.top.findNode("focusBorder") m.focusGlow = m.top.findNode("focusGlow") m.itemLabel = m.top.findNode("itemLabel") m.powerBtn = m.top.findNode("powerBtn") m.statusLabel = m.top.findNode("statusLabel") m.channelLabel = m.top.findNode("channelLabel") m.focusAnimation = m.top.findNode("focusAnimation")
m.top.scaleRotateCenter = [130, 110] m.top.scale = [1.0, 1.0]
m.top.observeField("itemContent", "itemContentChanged") m.top.observeField("state", "onStateChange") m.top.observeField("title", "onTitleChange") m.top.observeField("itemHasFocus", "onItemFocusChange") m.top.observeField("focusPercent", "onFocusPercentChange")
onTitleChange() onStateChange() onItemFocusChange() end sub
sub itemContentChanged() content = m.top.itemContent if content <> invalid if content.hasField("title") then m.top.title = content.title if content.hasField("state") then m.top.state = content.state if content.hasField("relayId") then m.top.relayId = content.relayId end if onTitleChange() onStateChange() end sub
sub onTitleChange() if m.itemLabel = invalid then return title = "CANAL " + m.top.relayId.ToStr() if m.top.title <> invalid and m.top.title.ToStr() <> "" title = UCase(m.top.title.ToStr()) end if m.itemLabel.text = title end sub
sub onStateChange() st = "OFF" if m.top.state <> invalid then st = UCase(m.top.state.ToStr())
isOn = (st = "ON" or st = "TRUE" or st = "1") if isOn m.powerBtn.uri = "pkg:/images/btn_power_green.png" m.statusLabel.text = "LIGADO" m.statusLabel.color = "0x54E6A0FF" m.cardBg.color = "0x14261FFF" else m.powerBtn.uri = "pkg:/images/btn_power_red.png" m.statusLabel.text = "DESLIGADO" m.statusLabel.color = "0xFF7184FF" m.cardBg.color = "0x151D2BFF" end if end sub
sub onItemFocusChange() focused = false if m.top.itemHasFocus <> invalid then focused = m.top.itemHasFocus
m.focusBorder.visible = focused m.focusGlow.visible = focused if focused m.focusAnimation.control = "start" onFocusPercentChange() else m.focusAnimation.control = "stop" m.top.scale = [1.0, 1.0] m.focusBorder.opacity = 0.0 m.focusGlow.opacity = 0.0 end if end sub
sub onFocusPercentChange() if m.top.focusPercent = invalid then return percent = m.top.focusPercent if percent < 0.0 then percent = 0.0 if percent > 1.0 then percent = 1.0
amount = percent if m.top.itemHasFocus = false then amount = 1.0 - percent m.top.scale = [1.0 + (0.06 * amount), 1.0 + (0.06 * amount)] m.focusBorder.opacity = 0.95 * amount m.focusGlow.opacity = 0.74 * amount end sub
